whyItMatters: NVIDIA's massive Q2 beat (US$96.2B revenue, DC US$89B) and strong Q3 guide (US$108B) despite zero China DC assumptions shows AI infrastructure demand remains robust. For newbie investors: this validates the AI infrastructure thesis but highlights geopolitical risk. SPCX's NASDAQ listing creates first public access to SpaceX exposure. Macro backdrop: Fed decision Sep 15-16 and US Aug jobs data (Sep 4, 20:30 HKT) will set rate trajectory. China luxury watch: SHEIN (HK 625) debuts Sep 1 - consumer sentiment indicator. Portfolio diversification across SPYM (US), VEU (ex-US), and GLD (safe haven) provides balanced exposure during policy uncertainty.
